studies.title: Place-value numerals with zero
studies.caption: Brahmagupta sets out rules for calculating with zero in a place-value system of nine digits and a sign for nothing.
studies.prompt: Close study of a seventh-century Indian mathematicians hands arranging small counters in aligned place-value columns on a dust board, with an intentionally empty column; palm-leaf manuscript and stylus nearby. Modest setting in Bhinmal about628CE, no modern equations or modern Arabic printed numerals.
